title: ophrys argolica subsp. pollinensis
intro: Ophrys argolica subsp. pollinensis, commonly known as the Argolic Bee Orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This orchid species is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include being anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial. The therapeutic actions of the Argolic Bee Orchid are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
